evidence: simulated: built from published descriptions and measurements, not imaged tissue

ductTreeEndsInAcini.source: Endo H, et al. Fine reconstruction of the pancreatic ductular system at the onset of pancreatitis. Histol Histopathol 2002;17(1):107-12. doi:10.14670/HH-17.107
ductTreeEndsInAcini.note: Intercalated ducts branch and end in acini; no anastomoses among acini or their central lumina. Described in rat.

intraAcinarDuct.source: Endo H, et al. Fine reconstruction of the pancreatic ductular system at the onset of pancreatitis. Histol Histopathol 2002;17(1):107-12. doi:10.14670/HH-17.107
intraAcinarDuct.note: An intra-acinar duct formed only by centroacinar cells continues the intercalated duct into the acinus. Described in rat.

centroacinarIsDuctal.source: Beer RL, Parsons MJ, Rovira M. Centroacinar cells: at the center of pancreas regeneration. Dev Biol 2016;413(1):8-15. doi:10.1016/j.ydbio.2016.02.027
centroacinarIsDuctal.note: Centroacinar cells are a specialised ductal cell type at the start of the intercalated duct.

aciniAsGrapeLikeLobules.source: Kiemen AL, et al. CODA: quantitative 3D reconstruction of large tissues at cellular resolution. Nat Methods 2022;19(11):1490-1499. doi:10.1038/s41592-022-01650-9
aciniAsGrapeLikeLobules.note: Acinar lobules appear as bunches of grape-like structures at the ends of the ducts in 3D reconstructions of human pancreas.

zymogenGranuleDiameterUm.source: Messenger SW, Falkowski MA, Groblewski GE. Ca2+-regulated secretory granule exocytosis in pancreatic and parotid acinar cells. Cell Calcium 2014;55(6):369-75. doi:10.1016/j.ceca.2014.03.003
zymogenGranuleDiameterUm.note: About 1 um; measured at 0.98 +/- 0.19 um in rat (Nadelhaft 1973).

granulesApical.source: Ermak TH, Rothman SS. Zymogen granules of pancreas decrease in size in response to feeding. Cell Tissue Res 1981;214(1):51-66. doi:10.1007/BF00235144
granulesApical.note: Granules fill the apical portion of the acinar cell; about 45 per cell section in fasted rat, fewer after feeding.

granulesDrawnPerCell.note: A display choice: a cell holds many more than are drawn.

meanNuclearRadiusUm.source: Kiemen AL, et al. CODA: quantitative 3D reconstruction of large tissues at cellular resolution. Nat Methods 2022;19(11):1490-1499. doi:10.1038/s41592-022-01650-9
meanNuclearRadiusUm.note: Average radius of nuclei in human pancreas H&E sections, across cell types. Acinar nuclei are drawn larger.

acinarCellHeightUm.note: Base to apex of a pyramidal acinar cell.

acinarCellBaseUm.note: Width of the base along the basement membrane.

acinusRadiusUm.note: Acini drawn as rounded berries of varying size: acinar cells converge on a central lumen like the segments of an orange.

centroacinarCellsPerAcinus.note: Lining the intra-acinar duct in the neck of the acinus.

centroacinarSizeUm.note: Flattened, pale cells: length along the duct, width, thickness. Nucleus elongated.

intraAcinarDuctLengthUm.note: How far the centroacinar cells reach into the acinus.

intercalatedDuctOuterRadiusUm.note: Low, flattened epithelium continuous with the centroacinar cells.

ductCellLengthUm.note: Length of a duct cell along the duct.

blockSizeUm.note: A display choice: a cube taken from inside a lobule, containing one islet.

collagenAlignedAlongDucts.source: Kiemen AL, et al. CODA: quantitative 3D reconstruction of large tissues at cellular resolution. Nat Methods 2022;19(11):1490-1499. doi:10.1038/s41592-022-01650-9
collagenAlignedAlongDucts.note: Collagen fibres are highly aligned along the long axis of the ducts, vessels and nerves they surround.

collagenFraction.source: Kiemen AL, et al. CODA: quantitative 3D reconstruction of large tissues at cellular resolution. Nat Methods 2022;19(11):1490-1499. doi:10.1038/s41592-022-01650-9
collagenFraction.note: About 6% of normal pancreas: inferred from a cancer sample at 87% collagen, described as a 14-fold increase over normal.

capillaryRadiusUm.note: Lumen of about 6 um, just wide enough for red cells in single file.

capillaryReachUm.note: Capillaries are added until most acini have one within this distance of their surface; a modelling rule.

redCellSizeUm.note: Diameter and thickness of a red blood cell; a textbook value.

stellateCellSizeUm.note: Spindle-shaped periacinar stellate cells and fibroblasts: length, width, thickness.

acinusGeometry.deformation: each acinus lists ext: how far each of its cells reaches from the centre, in the order of its cell directions
acinusGeometry.cellsPerAcinusNote: each acinus lists its radius r and its number of cells
acinusGeometry.note: A rounded acinus: rounded wedge-shaped cells converge on a small central lumen like orange segments, their directions spread evenly over the sphere except where the intra-acinar duct enters from -z; centroacinar cells line that duct from the mouth to the lumen.

result.note: The block was chosen to hold an islet, so its islet fraction is far above the 1-2% of the whole gland; stroma, vessels and nerves between the acini are not drawn.
